notes: NE 2025 vintage available on Justia. Nebraska is a unicameral state, and accordingly the Justia 2025 statute index is flat — chapters appear directly under the state-year root with no separate title/code level (other states with bicameral codifications often have a 'Legislature' title with House/Senate splits; NE does not). Pass-1 chose Chapter 49 (labeled 'Law' on Justia, despite housing the Nebraska Political Accountability and Disclosure Act §§49-1401 et seq.); Chapter 32 (Elections) intentionally excluded as separate campaign-finance regime; Chapter 50 (Legislature) and Chapter 84 (State Officers) reviewed and ruled out. Pass-2 fetch on chapter-49/ returned a section-level TSV (per-section leaf convention, matching WI 2025 Example D); pass-3 not invoked because section URLs are already the leaves. Selected 17 sections (49-1480 through 49-1492.01) constituting the NPADA lobbying disclosure body — covering lobbyist/principal registration, registration fees, activity and financial statement filings, Clerk-of-Legislature referral and public-records summary, statement-period rules, recordkeeping, gift restrictions, false-statement prohibitions, and prohibited practices/penalties. Regime prior cited §§49-1480 through 49-1492.06; sections 49-1492.02-.06 do not appear in the 2025 Justia index (presumed never enacted or subsequently transferred), so the actual lobbying range is 49-1480 through 49-1492.01. NPADA definitions (49-1403 et seq.) and the Nebraska Accountability and Disclosure Commission infrastructure (49-14,105 et seq., 49-14,123 duties, 49-14,124-126 enforcement, 49-14,134 false-statement penalty) live in the same Chapter 49 but apply to ALL four NPADA regimes (campaign finance, lobbying, financial-interest statements, conflicts of interest), so omitted from proposed_urls to keep the bundle tight to the lobbying-specific body — same convention used by WI 2025 and MA 2025. Administered by the Nebraska Accountability and Disclosure Commission. Tree depth 4 (state -> vintage -> chapter -> section), matching WI 2025.
